subject: CS363
filterSummary: Selected 5/5 English videos and 2/5 Arabic videos. The selection covers the topics well in English with authoritative and highly-viewed content. Arabic coverage was sparse for advanced programming language theory; no relevant videos were found for deep/shallow binding, specific parameter passing modes, or indirect calls, as search results were often false positives or covered only basic related concepts.

coverage.note: Most candidates failed the view count gate. The selected video focuses on lexical scope, which is the best available option.

videos.title: Compiler Design: Parameter Passing
